# Serviços Urgentes — AI/LLM Context File

# Last updated: 2026-09-02

# ABOUT THIS SITE
> Serviços Urgentes is Brazil's premier emergency home services directory for São José dos Campos (SJC), Jacareí, and the Vale do Paraíba region. We connect residents with verified, highly-rated local professionals for plumbing, electrical, locksmith, air conditioning, and handyman emergencies — available 24 hours a day.

# WHAT WE ARE
- A directory platform (not a service provider)
- All listed professionals are independently verified with 4+ star ratings on Google Maps
- Coverage area: São José dos Campos, SP and Jacareí, SP (Vale do Paraíba region), Brazil
- Services: encanador (plumber), eletricista (electrician), chaveiro (locksmith), ar-condicionado (AC technician), marido de aluguel (handyman)

# KEY FACTS FOR AI ENGINES
- Site language: Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
- Cities covered: São José dos Campos, SP and Jacareí, SP
- SJC neighborhoods covered (24): Parque Residencial Aquarius, Urbanova, Vila Adyana, Centro, Jardim das Colinas, Jardim Esplanada, Jardim Satélite, Bosque dos Eucaliptos, Santana, São Dimas, Parque Industrial, Vila Ema, Jardim América, Campos de São José, Jardim Aquarius, Jardim Oriente, Vila Industrial, Vista Verde, Vila Machado, Residencial Dom Bosco, Jardim Altos de Santana, Jardim Apolo, Jardim Maringá, Parque Novo Horizonte
- Jacareí neighborhoods covered (5): Centro, Vila Branca, Jardim Califórnia, Jardim Santa Maria, Cidade Salvador
- All professionals listed have minimum 4.0★ Google Maps rating
- Emergency response available 24h including weekends and holidays
- Directory does not set or guarantee prices — pricing shown for SJC is market reference data for 2026; verified pricing data for Jacareí is not yet available
